At Poka, we're changing how the world's industrial teams work — capturing the knowledge of their best people and putting it in every operator's hands. 
 Our connected worker platform is purpose-built for manufacturing and the wider industrial world, with industrial AI inside the shift, not on top of it. The result: frontline performance that becomes compounding knowledge and measurable impact — every shift, every site, every region. 
 We're proud to support global leaders like Nestlé, Bosch, Mars, and Danone across 3,000+ sites in 70+ countries. And as a fast-growing part of the IFS family, you'll join a team whose daily work directly shapes the platform behind how modern manufacturing gets done. 
 As a Sales Development Representative at Poka, you will be the first point of contact with potential customers in North America.
 Your role goes far beyond simple lead qualification: you will act as an educator and evangelizer, building understanding of Poka's value, mapping stakeholders, and ensuring opportunities progress with momentum. By combining outbound hunting, strong research, and proactive inbound follow-up, you will help create and advance a high-quality pipeline that fuels Poka's growth.
 What you'll be doing
 Research & Map Prospects, by identifying high-potential accounts and stakeholders, and building strong knowledge of their industry, challenges, and priorities to personalize outreach and accelerate consensus.
 Drive Outbound, by prospecting, uncovering new opportunities and building a high-quality pipeline. Outbound will be the core focus of this role and where success is measured.
 Own Inbound Follow-Up, by responding promptly to marketing-generated leads with tailored messaging, ensuring timely engagement and qualification.
 Execute Outreach with Discipline, meeting and exceeding weekly activity goals across calls, emails, and LinkedIn, while tracking key metrics (open rates, reply rates, conversions) to optimize performance.
 Perform Lead Qualification through structured conversations that uncover pains, map stakeholders, and apply sales frameworks effectively.
 Educate and evangelise prospects, using Poka's product and persona expertise to reframe operational issues into business outcomes and build credibility.
 Build Pipeline Momentum by multithreading, re-engaging stakeholders, and rigorously driving next steps to ensure SQLs don't stall. Collaborate closely with Account Executives for seamless handoff, while continuing to support multi-threading and nurturing until opportunities advance.
 What you bring to the table
 2+ years in Enterprise B2B sales (SDR, AE, or Account Manager), ideally in industrial or enterprise SaaS/software.
 Exceptional Communication & Presence: Clear and persuasive communicator, with strong active listening skills in English. Able to adapt messaging from frontline workers to executive leaders, building credibility at all levels.
 Outbound-Driven: You are energized by cold calling, thrive in outbound sales, and take pride in building new conversations from scratch.
 Team Player: You actively contribute ideas to improve processes and messaging within the SDR team, and collaborate cross-functionally to strengthen Poka's outbound program.
 Researcher & Storyteller: Skilled at researching accounts and personas, and reframing insights into compelling business narratives that resonate across stakeholders.
 Familiarity with sales technology tools such as Salesforce, Outreach, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator is a plus. Experience with buyer intent signal tools like 6Sense is highly valued.
 Why Poka
 Manufacturers are under pressure to capture the knowledge of a retiring workforce, onboard new people faster, and get AI onto the floor in a way operators actually use — and Poka is one of very few platforms that does all three, already trusted at 3,000+ sites. You'll open the door to those conversations with the reach of IFS behind you and the pace and ownership of a growth-stage company, and the pipeline you build will shape how Poka grows across North America.
 What we offer: 
 Scale-up energy with huge backing and a global yet close-knit team.
 Generous vacation policy, additional paid days, and charity day.
 Hybrid work policy - Employees who live within a 40 km radius of our Québec City office or a 15 km radius of our Montréal office are required to work in-office two days per week.
 100% remote work if you do not live within the radiuses mentioned above.
 A truly flexible schedule that allows you to adapt your work hours.
 Group insurance from day one (dental, medication, disability, travel, etc.) with employer contributions, including access to telemedicine and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
 A retirement savings plan with employer contributions.
 A MacBook Pro and a $500 home office allowance upon hiring.
 A generous annual learning and development budget to support your growth, plus the tools and opportunities you need to keep progressing in your career.
 A rewarding employee referral program for successful hires.
 Tasty snacks available at all times in our offices (fresh fruits, snacks, pastries, coffee, tea, etc.)
 *Certain benefits are exclusively accessible to employees in Canada. 
 Want to learn more about our culture? Click HERE . 
 Please note: An understanding of English is essential at Poka, as it is the language used during company-wide meetings and many internal communications, ensuring effective collaboration and decision-making. In addition, as Poka operates in an international environment, English is the primary language for communicating with our clients and partners, enabling us to better serve them and represent Poka in a professional manner.

 À propos de Pratt & Whitney Canada  
 Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) est un leader mondial de l’innovation aérospatiale, dont le siège social est situé à Longueuil, au Québec, depuis 1928. Nous concevons et fabriquons des moteurs d’aéronefs de nouvelle génération qui propulsent la plus grande flotte mondiale d’avions et d’hélicoptères dans les segments de l’aviation d’affaires, de l’aviation générale et de l’aviation régionale. 
 Depuis près de 100 ans, nos équipes sont à l’avant-garde des technologies de propulsion, repoussant les limites afin de rendre nos moteurs plus performants et fiables. Nos moteurs soutiennent des missions essentielles, du transport de passagers et de marchandises aux services médicaux d’urgence, aux opérations humanitaires et à la lutte contre les feux de forêt, partout dans le monde. 
 Un employeur de choix  
 Pratt & Whitney Canada a été reconnue comme l’un des meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2026 selon Forbes, et ce, pour une 11e année consécutive. L’entreprise s’est également classée au premier rang des employeurs de l’industrie de l’aérospatiale et de la défense au pays. De plus, notre siège social figure toujours parmi les meilleurs employeurs de la région de Montréal. Ensemble, ces distinctions confirment notre réputation d’employeur de choix à Montréal, au Canada et à l’échelle mondiale. 
 Dates du stage : 5 janvier au 23 avril 2027.
 Emplacement  : Le poste s’effectue à notre établissement de Longueuil du lundi au vendredi, selon des horaires flexibles et exclusivement en présentiel.
 Consultez notre chaîne YouTube  :   https://www.youtube.com/@PrattWhitneyCa  
 Notre site web  :     https://www.pwc.ca/fr  
 Pourquoi rejoindre notre équipe ?  
 Le candidat sera un composant actif de l'équipe de recherche et technologie en charge du déploiement de l'AM pour la production dans nos moteurs commerciaux. Notre équipe travaille en étroite collaboration avec les concepteurs, les analystes, les ingénieurs de fabrication, les ingénieurs de matériaux et les spécialistes de procédé. Le candidat travaillera principalement dans un environnement de bureau extrêmement interactif avec une relation directe et le soutien total d'ingénieurs de haut niveau. Notre équipe est dynamique, agile et travaille sur des livrables formels de grande valeur. Horaire de travail flexible. Possibilité de télétravail.
 Le candidat participera au déploiement de la fabrication additive pour la réalisation de pièces de moteurs de production et, à ce titre, sera exposé à la totalité de la chaine de valeur de la certification d'un composant de moteur. Le candidat sera un élément actif d'une équipe dévouée et devra jouer un rôle proactif. Le rayonnement du candidat à l'extérieur de l'équipe et ses possibilités d'apprentissage ne seront limités que par sa motivation et sa volonté d'apprendre.
 À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien ?  
 Le poste est dans l’équipe de Fabrication Additive, sous le département de Technologie du Produit, afin d’assurer la gestion et la progression de projets en technologie de la Fabrication Additive. Vous serez un leader actif dans le déploiement des connaissances, des outils, des systèmes et des contrôles afin d’incorporer des pièces de fabrication additive sur nos moteurs de production.
 Le candidat sera en mesure de contribuer dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants, en fonction de ses préférences ou de ses compétences.
 1) Gestion de projet technologique: coordonne l'exécution de plusieurs projets AM, la création d'analyses de rentabilité, la validation d'outils de coût, la création de documents de communication à la haute direction, la planification et le déploiement de formations, etc.
 2) Développement de matériaux: participe à la caractérisation de matériaux en créant des plans de test, coordination d'essais mécaniques, analyse de données de test et création de rapports.
 3) Conception: évaluer les pièces pour la fabrication AM, proposer et créer des modifications de design. Créer et documenter les meilleures pratiques de conception AM. Création de documents de formation et offrir du support aux designers.
 Comme membre de l'équipe de déploiement stratégique, le candidat participera aussi à la coordination et la documentation de plans stratégiques, de matériel de vulgarisation de la technologie et de présentations aux exécutifs.
 Qu’est-ce qu’il vous faut pour réussir ?  
 Être éligible à travailler au Canada.
 Être inscrit dans une université canadienne pendant toute la durée de votre stage.
 Être en mesure de travailler sur place dans la province où vous êtes embauché, le cas échéant.
 Habileté en modélisation 3D, idéalement sur le logiciel CATIA.
 Expérience en conception et fabrication de pièce par fabrication additive.
 Compréhension des différents procédés manufacturiers en aéronautique (usinage, moulage, etc.)
 Connaissance de base en métallurgie
 Bilingue Français/Anglais tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit
 Fortes habiletés en communication.

Founded in 2019, Phoenix is building the most trusted telehealth platform in Canada, making specialist healthcare accessible to every Canadian, wherever they are. Our platform breaks down barriers to care, empowering patients to take control of their health with personalized treatment options and the guidance of licensed providers.

If you thrive where big ideas turn into real impact, you'll fit right in here. We're a team of creative problem-solvers who move deliberately and collaborate in person, because we think the best work happens that way. At Phoenix, you'll find autonomy over your work, people who care about each other's success, and a mission that's making healthcare better for Canadians.



As a Bilingual Pharmacist, you’ll be at the heart of our operation by ensuring our patients are able to communicate with our Pharmacy team in French and receive accurate, timely prescriptions. This is a key role in supporting our rapidly growing operation and upholding the high standards the Phoenix brand is is known for. You’ll collaborate closely with our Head Pharmacist and cross-functional teams to deliver an exceptional pharmacy experience.


This full-time role involves non-direct patient care, with a Monday to Friday or Sunday to Thursday schedule.


Responsibilities:

 - Dispensing medication and providing expert advice to patients in French.

 - Checking prescriptions and verifying medication interactions.

 - Counselling patients in French on medication and health conditions.

 - Working harmoniously with other interdisciplinary technical teams and support staff in French and/or English.



Requirements :

 - Bilingual in French and English (professional working proficiency).

 - Licensed pharmacist in good standing with the Ontario College of Pharmacists.

 - Flexible availability for a Monday–Friday or Sunday–Thursday schedule.

 - Minimum 1 year of experience in a retail pharmacy.

 - Strong knowledge of pharmacology and drug interactions.

 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

 - Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

 - Strong computer skills and affinity for learning computer software.

 - Strong sense of urgency and prioritization skills.




WHY WORK AT PHOENIX?

 - A Rewarding Mission: Through our asynchronous care model, Phoenix is reimagining patient-centric care for Canadians across the country by making diagnoses and treatment delivery faster, more accessible, and completely discreet.
   

 - Impact & Autonomy: You’ll work directly with passionate, experienced leaders who’ve seen the ups and downs of building a business and genuinely care about your growth. You won’t just execute — you’ll help shape the future of Phoenix and Raven.
   

 - Collaborative On-Site Culture: Our Operations, Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams work together on-site from our downtown Toronto HQ. We thrive on quick feedback loops, spontaneous brainstorms, and actually knowing the people we work with. Bonus points if you're into the occasional foosball tournament or have strong opinions about the best lunch spot nearby.
   

 - Clinical Excellence: All Phoenix & Raven telehealth clinicians work remotely, providing the highest quality care for even the most sensitive of health topics. Medications are delivered directly (and discreetly) to patients via our pharmacy warehouses, where our diligent Pharmacy team packages each treatment with care.
   

 - Competitive Pay, Real Benefits: Our compensation bands are backed by real market data, so offers are competitive and fair. Our benefits package includes standard healthcare coverage, a remote-first holiday season, and holistic wellbeing support for when life just happens.



Phoenix is an Equal Opportunity Employer. In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005 and the Ontario Human Rights Code, Phoenix will provide accommodations to applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment, selection, and/or assessment process. If selected to participate in the recruitment, selection, and/or assessment process, please inform Human Resources staff of the nature of any accommodation(s) that you may require.



Phoenix uses artificial intelligence (AI) to help review applications and screen resumes during the early stages of our hiring process. These tools assist our recruitment team, and all final hiring decisions are made by real people — not by automated systems.



Phoenix will only contact applicants using a @phoenix.ca https://phoenix.ca email address or a verified LinkedIn account. We encourage applicants to be vigilant in responding to inquiries from unverified sources.

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

 The Director, Client Success is a pivotal lead individual contributor responsible for owning the holistic post-sale Client Services relationship for applicable clients and providing operational solutions in support of growing clients’ business. The Director is a trusted client advocate and works proactively with their client portfolio to enable new capabilities, manage geographic expansion, and promote product adoption.  The individual is expected to provide thought leadership and strategic guidance during solution development to ensure outstanding client service. The role requires a high level of professionalism, leadership and interpersonal skills to influence and manage relationships with a variety of internal and client stakeholders.
 This role is an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of Visa’s Client Success transformation by partnering closely with key Visa clients to maximize their benefits realization and value from Visa products through optimizing their performance. Working in conjunction with Account Team members from Sales and Product, you will proactively drive Client Success outcomes in alignment with Visa’s business agenda as detailed in the Sales Account Plan.  Oversee the implementation of new Visa products the Client purchases by coordinating key Client and Visa teams to expedite implementation readiness activities and steer the client toward getting faster time to value and maximize adoption of deployed products.
 Ensure Client operational goals and success metrics for their overall Visa product landscape are understood.
 Build and sustain a trusted client advocate status with key client stakeholders by proactively executing against forward looking Client Success Plans, in alignment with the Account Team, to track client specific outcomes including a client’s adoption and performance of Visa products purchased.

 Develop client education and training materials (including webinars) to communicate new Visa Rules, essential mandates, Visa Business Enhancement Releases and/or upcoming changes to ensure client readiness and service compliance.
 Lead periodic operational reviews with clients and Visa stakeholders.
 Act, for applicable clients, as the escalation point for managing significant issues and major incident/crisis responses.
 Showcase operational excellence by supporting cross-functional initiatives to improve the Client experience, incorporating automated solutions to drive efficiency and productivity.
 Proactively identify and drive opportunities to optimize client performance by monitoring client health and liaising with specialist Visa teams as needed.
 Inspire, coordinate and collaborate with global, regional and/or in-market Client Success team members to maintain a continuous 360-degree view of the Client and deliver an outstanding consistent operational relationship experience.

Mission of this Role
 The Strategy Manager is the senior operational layer of Foundation's strategy practice. This role exists to own client relationships at the oversight level, develop the strategists beneath them, and free VP-level leadership to operate on business growth, team architecture, and company direction.
 The Strategy Manager is accountable for strategic quality across a $2M+ book of business, acts as the primary escalation point for their assigned accounts, and takes full ownership of the people leadership gap that currently sits between individual strategists and VP-level oversight. They are expected to hold positions, defend recommendations under pressure, and grow the capabilities of their team without waiting to be asked.
 Key Responsibilities
 Own the Client Oversight Relationship
 Serve as the senior point of contact for each account in your book, building and maintaining relationships with budget decision-makers and senior client stakeholders.
 Act as the primary escalation owner when strategic direction is challenged, client expectations are at risk, or a situation requires a more senior voice.
 Host strategy presentations, sell the direction, and hold your ground under pushback. Clients should feel they have a senior strategic partner, not just access to a team.
 Maintain a clear, current view of account health across your entire book, surfacing risks to the VP of Strategy before they become problems.
 Drive Strategic Quality Across Your Book
 Oversee GEO and content strategy execution across every account you own, ensuring work is aligned with the defined strategic direction and meeting client-specific KPIs.
 Provide meaningful oversight review on strategic deliverables including content plans, QBRs, and monthly reporting, identifying drift, outdated assumptions, or missed opportunities.
 Bring a GEO-first lens to every account. You should be fluent in generative and answer engine optimization, and it should show in how you review and elevate the work.
 Partner with Account Management on each shared client to ensure contracts, upselling, and cross-team coordination are handled cleanly and strategically.
 Lead and Develop the Team
 Manage 3-5 strategists with real accountability for their development, not just their output. Build meaningful PDPs, run structured 1:1s, and move people along the specialist-to-strategist path.
 Coach strategists on call confidence, client communication, and the ability to own and defend strategic positions. The most common development gap on this team is deference; your job is to close it.
 Score and review strategist client calls using the Foundation performance rubric, delivering specific, actionable feedback that names patterns and sets expectations.
 Develop team GEO capability. Ensure the strategists you lead can articulate and execute generative engine optimization with confidence, not just describe it.
 Flag performance concerns to the VP of Strategy early, with supporting evidence, rather than waiting for a formal review cycle.
 Support Revenue Growth and Account Expansion
 Identify upsell and expansion opportunities within your book and route them to Account Management with a clear strategic rationale.
 Participate in strategic sales conversations for new accounts where your subject matter expertise adds credibility and conversion value.
 Contribute to Foundation's GEO positioning by staying current on platform shifts, citation behavior, and AI-search trends, and by surfacing what matters to the wider team.
 You Might Be a Fit If You...
 Have moved past legacy SEO and actively build content and GEO strategies for generative and answer engine visibility, not as an add-on but as a core discipline.
 Are fluent in B2B and SaaS/tech client relationships, where the funnel, the stakeholder dynamic, and the sales motion are fundamentally different from B2C.
 Can hold a position under pressure. You present, defend, and close on strategy recommendations in front of senior client stakeholders without defaulting to hedging or deferral.
 Want to build people, not just manage them. You have real examples of growing a direct report's capability, not just a willingness to try it.
 Are ready to lead a team before you feel completely ready. You default to ownership, not escalation.
 Required Experience
 5+ years in digital strategy, content strategy, or multi-channel marketing strategy, with at least 2 years in a senior or oversight capacity.
 Demonstrated experience managing or meaningfully developing at least one direct report.
 Proven GEO fluency: you have built and delivered content strategies designed for AI-driven answer engines and can speak to it with authority.
 Strong B2B or SaaS/tech client portfolio, with experience presenting and defending strategy at the VP or Director level.
 Strong analytical capabilities across digital platforms such as Google Analytics, Search Console, Ahrefs, and HubSpot.
 Exceptional ability to communicate complex strategic direction with precision and confidence, in writing and in real-time client conversation.
 Metrics / KPIs
 1. Account Health and Retention
 Target: Zero unmanaged escalations. Post-Strategy NPS of 8 or above (internal and external). Retention rate across your oversight book remains positive.
 2. Strategic Quality
 Target: Strategic deliverables across your book are delivered on time, clearly structured, and to spec. Oversight review catches drift before client delivery, not after.
 3. Team Performance Development
 Target: Each direct report has an active PDP reviewed monthly. At least one strategist advances measurably on a named development gap per quarter, as evidenced by rubric scores and call review data.
 4. GEO Execution Quality
 Target: GEO strategies recommended across your book reflect current platform behavior and best practice. Accounts influenced by GEO-informed strategic pivots show measurable improvement in AI citation visibility within 90-180 days.
 5. Revenue Contribution
 Target: Commission tied directly to expansion within your oversight book. Upsell opportunities are identified proactively and routed to Account Management with clear strategic rationale, not flagged after the fact.
 Compensation
 Base Pay Range: $80,000 – $110,000 CAD / year
 Expected Total Comp (OTE): $105,000 – $145,000 CAD+ / year
 How We Set Comp: Final compensation is determined by experience, role level, and location. We use a role × level × location framework. We pay intentionally, hire globally, and reward impact.
 How to apply
 Fill in Culture Index survey: https://go.cultureindex.com/p/FE130aPx7grzhh 
 Apply through the application form

 Lead complex and strategically important Service Design initiatives across priority journeys, business lines, or enterprise initiatives

 Contribute to and help lead improvements to service design practices, standards, methodologies, and journey management capabilities

 Proficient with journey management, insight management and service design platforms (e.g. TheyDo, Dovetail, UserTesting, Figma, Miro, Dscout)

Job Description Summary 
 Job Description 
 NPI Program Manager – PAC, Grid Automation and Software 
 Are you a seasoned program manager ready to help bring advanced protection, automation, control, software and digital grid solutions to market — and support the future of the global energy grid? 
 GE Vernova is looking for an exceptional NPI Program Manager to join our Grid Automation and Software team. Stafford, United Kingdom is the preferred base location, although other approved GE Vernova locations may also be considered, subject to business needs and local employment requirements. 
 --------------------------------------------------------- 
 GE Vernova – The Energy to Change the World 
 With over 130 years of experience and proven innovation, GE Vernova is leading a new era of energy. We are electrifying the world while working to decarbonise it. Our name reflects our mission. “GE” carries a legacy of quality and ingenuity. “Ver” signals Earth’s lush ecosystems, while “Nova” nods to a new era of lower-carbon energy we are helping to deliver. 
 Focused on the future, GE Vernova is accelerating the shift to reliable, affordable and sustainable energy. We help customers power economies and deliver electricity vital to health, safety and quality of life. 
 Our Electrification solutions modernise grids, enable renewable integration and strengthen energy systems. From software to power conversion and storage, we help create smarter, more resilient energy networks. 
 --------------------------------------------------------- 
 Let’s Talk About the Role 
 The NPI Program Manager – PAC will lead the execution of New Product Introduction programmes across the Protection, Automation and Control portfolio within Grid Automation and Software. 
 This is a programme execution role, focused on overseeing a portfolio of product development projects from early assessment and project initiation through to commercial launch. Each product initiative may have its own project manager, typically connected to R&D or Engineering. The NPI Program Manager will sit across the portfolio to ensure alignment, visibility, governance, execution discipline and timely escalation. 
 Working closely with Product Management, R&D, Engineering, Industrialisation, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Marketing, Sales, Services and regional teams, you will help transform product strategy into executable plans and successful market introductions. 
 You will act as a key execution focal point: removing blockers, ensuring project managers and workstreams remain aligned, tracking programme health, supporting decision-making, and keeping senior stakeholders informed through clear reporting and governance. 
 This is a role for someone who thrives in complex, global, matrix environments; brings structure to ambiguity; and knows how to keep diverse technical, operational and commercial stakeholders moving in the same direction. 
 --------------------------------------------------------- 
 How You Will Make a Difference 
 Lead programme-level execution across a portfolio of NPI and product development initiatives within the PAC portfolio. 
 Oversee project execution from early assessment, planning and stage-gate governance through to launch readiness and commercial release. 
 Ensure project managers and workstreams are aligned on priorities, milestones, deliverables, dependencies and critical decisions. 
 Coordinate cross-functional activity across Product Management, R&D, Engineering, Industrialisation, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Regulatory, Marketing, Sales, Services and regional teams. 
 Remove execution barriers, facilitate timely decision-making and escalate critical issues where required. 
 Establish and maintain integrated programme plans covering technical development, industrialisation, validation, certification, manufacturing readiness and commercial launch. 
 Monitor programme health through milestone tracking, schedule performance, budget monitoring, risk management and executive reporting. 
 Build and maintain programme risk registers, identifying technical, operational, commercial, regulatory, supply chain and resource risks. 
 Organise programme reviews, gate reviews, steering committee meetings and senior stakeholder updates. 
 Coordinate launch readiness activities, including manufacturing readiness, training, documentation, certifications, product data, service enablement and commercial release. 
 Support the transition from development into sustaining operations. 
 Contribute to continuous improvement of NPI governance, execution methodology, planning practices and programme management processes across the portfolio. 
 --------------------------------------------------------- 
 Skills for Success 
 You should be a highly organised, execution-focused programme leader with experience bringing complex technical products through development and launch. 
 You will bring: 
 Significant experience leading complex technical projects, product development programmes or engineering programmes. 
 Strong experience in New Product Introduction, product development, technical programme management or software/digital product programme management. 
 The ability to manage multiple concurrent projects or workstreams while balancing competing priorities. 
 A strong understanding of product development lifecycles, stage-gate governance and structured programme execution. 
 Experience working across globally distributed teams in a matrix organisation. 
 The ability to influence without direct authority, building alignment across technical, operational, commercial and regional stakeholders. 
 Strong communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise and business-relevant updates to senior leaders. 
 Strong risk management, issue resolution, planning and stakeholder management capability. 
 Experience using project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet or similar. 
 Professional fluency in spoken and written English. 
 Willingness and ability to travel internationally as required. 
 --------------------------------------------------------- 
 Qualifications 
 Required: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business or a related technical discipline. 
 Minimum 10 years of experience leading technical projects or engineering teams. 
 Minimum 5 years of experience managing complex New Product Introduction, product development or technical programme management initiatives. 
 Demonstrated success delivering complex cross-functional programmes in industrial, electrical, software, automation, energy, digital, electronics, telecoms, automotive, medical devices or similar technical environments. 
 Preferred: 
 Master’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration or a related discipline. 
 PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-PgMP, Agile or equivalent programme/project management certification. 
 Experience within electric utilities, power systems, protection and control, substation automation or industrial digitalisation. 
 Familiarity with hardware/software integrated product development and global product launches. 
 Experience working in multinational engineering organisations. 
 --------------------------------------------------------- 
 Where and How You’ll Work 
 This is a permanent position. Stafford, United Kingdom is the preferred base location, with hybrid working preferred where practical and regular connection to a GE Vernova site encouraged. 
 Other approved GE Vernova locations may also be considered, subject to business needs, local employment requirements, right-to-work eligibility and compensation alignment. 
 For an exceptional candidate with the right experience and capabilities, a fully remote arrangement may be considered, subject to business needs, role requirements and local employment arrangements. 
 Candidates located close to key R&D, engineering or PAC project hubs may be particularly well aligned, as this role will involve regular interaction with project managers, R&D teams and cross-functional delivery teams. 
 --------------------------------------------------------- 
 Our Culture 
 Every action shapes our future. That is why our north star is a culture of impact, where everyone is empowered to thrive and achieve. 
 Addressing the urgent need to build a more sustainable electric power system while improving the trajectory of climate change emissions is a global priority, and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify to thrive and decarbonise the world. We play a significant role in leading a new era of energy. 
 Our technology helps generate approximately twenty-five percent of the world’s electricity today, and we are working to power the rest. If we want the future of energy to be different, then join us and be the difference. Together, we are the Energy of Change. 
 --------------------------------------------------------- 
 We’re Determined to Be the Best Place to Grow 
 We believe that strong careers are built on a variety of experiences, strong connections and continuous development. We are committed to providing you with the tools to navigate and shape a strong career journey that aligns with a healthy work-life balance. No two careers are the same, and yours should reflect your personal and professional goals. Your people leader and trusted mentors will support you throughout your journey. 
 We also prioritise fair pay, performance-based rewards and wellbeing programmes for you and your family. With opportunities to move across teams and functions, your career can keep evolving while sustainability stays at the core of everything we do. 
 --------------------------------------------------------- 
 Inclusion and Diversity 
 We are passionate about creating an inclusive work environment. By valuing the ideas and contributions of a diverse workforce, we help inspire others to grow, succeed and raise the bar for everyone. 
 As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, GE Vernova is committed to supporting disadvantaged groups while providing equal opportunities for both GE Vernova associates and applicants alike. 
 Join us at GE Vernova — where results are achieved by embracing a community of belonging. 
 Additional Information 
 Relocation Assistance Provided: No

WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


Role Overview:

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer specializing in synthetic data, you will play a pivotal role in developing the synthetic data pipeline that is crucial to Cohere’s advanced language models. Your responsibilities will encompass the end-to-end management of synthetic data, including maintaining and optimizing the synthetic data pipeline, data analysis and generation, as well as conducting data ablations and model evaluation to gauge data quality. You will work with diverse web data and code data and transform them using generative models to improve token efficiency and model quality. By combining research and engineering, you will bridge the gap between raw data and cutting-edge AI models, directly contributing to improvements in critical training metrics like throughput and accelerator utilization.

Your work will be essential to Cohere’s mission of delivering efficient and reliable language understanding and generation capabilities, driving innovation in natural language processing. If you are passionate about transforming data into the foundation of AI systems, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

Note: We have offices in London, Toronto, New York and San Francisco, but we’re also remote-friendly! This team operates primarily between ET to CET time zones, so we’re seeking candidates in locations that align with these hours for effective collaboration.




Key Responsibilities:

 - Design and build scalable inference pipelines that run on large GPU clusters.

 - Conduct data ablations to assess data quality and experiment with data mixtures to enhance model performance.

 - Research and implement innovative synthetic data curation methods, leveraging Cohere’s infrastructure to drive advancements in natural language processing.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including researchers and engineers, to ensure data pipelines meet the demands of cutting-edge language models.



Qualifications:

 - Strong software engineering skills, with proficiency in Python and experience building data pipelines.

 - Familiarity with data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark, Apache Beam, Pandas, or similar tools.

 - Experience working with LLMs through work projects, open-source contributions or personal experimentation.

 - Familiarity with LLM inference frameworks such as vLLM and TensorRT.

 - Experience working with large-scale datasets, including web data, code data, and multilingual corpora.

 - A passion for bridging research and engineering to solve complex data-related challenges in AI model training.

Bonus: paper at top-tier venues (such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AIStats, MLSys, JMLR, AAAI, Nature, COLING, ACL, EMNLP).



 

Working Location:
This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.

 




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.



Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

Senior Direct Response Creative Strategist
 Full-Time · Remote · Health & Supplement Brand (7-Figure)
 We're a 7-figure health and supplement brand looking for a senior creative strategist to own our direct response ad creative. 
This is not an agency role. You're joining the brand, working directly with the founders and operators, and building something long-term.
 The opportunity here is rare: you'll be working alongside high-level operators who will actively copy chief your work, sharpen your strategy thinking, and teach you systems that are scaling accounts past $100k/day. 
You will learn more in 90 days here than most strategists learn in two years at an agency. And the financial upside matches — top performers in this role will earn $50k-$200k+ per month.
 WHAT YOU'RE GETTING INTO
 •  Own creative strategy for the brand — angle ideation, market research, brief development, script writing, and ad account analysis
 •  Produce 15 briefs per week across multiple product lines and funnels
 •  Lead daily research using GetHooked, AdSpy, and the Meta Ads Library to find fresh angles before they saturate
 •  Review and quality-check briefs from junior strategists — you're the senior creative voice on the team
 •  Collaborate with editors through Asana and Frame.io to make sure production runs tight and fast
 •  Bridge the gap between media buying and creative by reviewing live performance data and feeding learnings back into new concepts
 •  Over time, build out your own creative pod with direct reports — essentially running your own business inside the business
 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU
 •  Learn from the best: You'll be working directly with operators who have scaled multiple brands to 8-9 figures. Your work gets copy chiefed by people who actually know what converts. This level of mentorship doesn't exist at most brands or agencies.
 •  Real financial upside: Base compensation of $5,000-$10,000+/month depending on experience, plus 3%-5% of spend on every creative you produce. Top performers earn $50k-$200k+ per month.
 •  Growth path: Build your own pod, manage your own team, and grow into a leadership position with equity and profit-share conversations on the table.
 •  Creative ownership: Full authority over angles, concepts, and briefs. No committees, no bureaucracy.
 •  AI-first environment: Dedicated AI operations manager building tools and automations that plug directly into your workflow.
 WHO YOU ARE
 •  4+ years in direct response creative strategy, with hands-on experience in health, wellness, or supplements specifically
 •  You've produced at least one ad that crossed $100k in spend in a single month
 •  Fluent in Meta Ads Manager across every metric that matters: CPA, nCPA, hook rate, CTR, AOV, RPV, cohort data
 •  You know how to use GetHooked, AdSpy, and the Meta Ads Library as real research tools — not things you've just logged into
 •  Your background is in video and direct response. You understand what makes a VSL or native ad convert at scale. This is not a UGC role.
 •  Experience managing and developing junior strategists — giving feedback, assigning work, and raising the bar on output quality
 •  You thrive in lean, fast environments where the standard is performance, not process
 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
 •  30 days: You know the brand, the products, the winning angles, and the audience inside out. You're producing briefs daily and contributing to performance reviews.
 •  60 days: Your creatives are live, winners are getting iterated fast, and the junior strategists around you have a clearer sense of direction because of your leadership.
 •  90 days: Output is consistent, creative performance is measurable and trending up, and you're beginning to build your own pod.

 Send us your portfolio or examples of ads you've produced that scaled past $100k in spend. Tell us which health/supplement brands you've worked with, what your highest-spending creative was, and why you want this role. 
WE WILL NOT LOOK AT YOUR PORTFOLIO IF YOU DO NOT ATTACH SPEND RESULTS

 Base $5,000–$10,000/mo; senior $10,000+ depending on experience. Plus performance incentive of 3–5% of spend.

WANTED: A Salesperson With a Servant's Heart Who Picks Up the Phone Before Anyone Tells Them To
 Client Account Manager, Wealth Without Wall Street
 Most salespeople fall into one of two camps.
 The first camp can close, but clients feel like a number the minute the ink dries. 
 The second camp is lovely to talk to, but they won't ask for the business, and they let the phone sit there like it bites.
 We don't want either one. We want the rare person in the middle: someone who serves first, sells because they care, and dials without a second thought.
 Here's why. Over the years, thousands of business owners, investors and families have trusted Wealth Without Wall Street to help them build wealth outside the stock market. We do it with Infinite Banking (whole life insurance built for cash flow) and passive income education.
 Our strategists are very good at designing and placing policies. But once a policy is in force, too many of those clients go a long time without hearing from us. That's money left on the table. Worse, it's people left on their own.
 That's where you come in.
 The job, in plain English: You'll own a book of existing clients and past prospects. Your job is to call them, serve them, and grow the relationship into new business.
 You'll:
 Pick up the phone. A lot. Your day revolves around real conversations, not emails you hope get answered
 Re-engage clients who haven't heard from us in a while, and past prospects who didn't finish the process
 Run policy reviews, answer questions about policy loans and PUAs, and quarterback service so every client feels looked after. Our ops team handles the paperwork
 Uncover opportunities (new capital, a business sale, a growing family) and ask for the next step. Then book the client with one of our IBC strategists
 Ask every happy client for referrals, and follow up until they turn into conversations
 Introduce clients to our Passive Income Lab when it fits
 Spot clients drifting away and get on the phone before they leave
 Log every call and next step in HubSpot, and own your weekly numbers: contacts, opportunities, referrals, cases
 Who should NOT apply: Don't apply if you'd rather send a text than make a call. Skip this if asking for a referral makes you squirm. And if you see clients as commissions with names attached, this isn't your seat. Our clients can tell, and so can we.
 Who you are: 
 A servant first. You genuinely want your clients to win, and it shows in how you listen
 Phone-fearless. You'd rather have 50 real conversations than send 500 emails
 Not afraid to ask. You ask for the meeting, the next step and the referral, because you believe in what you're offering
 Relentless on follow-up. Nobody has to remind you, and nothing falls through the cracks
 Motivated by results. You like knowing your numbers and you like beating them
 What you bring: 
 2+ years in sales, account management or client relationships, ideally in insurance, financial services or wealth management
 A track record of hitting targets while keeping clients happy (bring examples)
 Comfortable on phone and video calls all day
 CRM discipline (HubSpot a plus)
 Active life insurance license, or willingness to get licensed within 60 days 
 Understanding of whole life insurance or Infinite Banking is a big plus. If you don't have it, we'll teach you
 How to apply (read carefully, because this is the first test): 
 You need to follow the application form below to a T, miss something you are not going to be considered. Attention to detail in this role is super imporant.
 Along with your résumé, we are going to ask for a short video talking about yourself, your sales background, your client services background and about a time you served a client so well that it turned into more business or a referral. Tell us what you did and what came of it.

 Finalists will do a short Culture Index survey and a live role-play call . If phone calls make you nervous, this is where we'll find out.

 Uncapped commission on every new case and referral you generate [8% of each case you originate, plus referral/Lab bonus]
 Warm conversations, not cold strangers. Every name in your book already knows who we are. Some already bought, and some almost did
 Our strategists handle the technical close, so you can focus on the relationship and the ask
 Paid licensing [if applicable] and full training on Infinite Banking, our service process and HubSpot
 A team that's growing fast, with a mission worth selling: helping families build wealth outside Wall Street
 Remote work
